visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of sausages on a charcoal grill with thick white smoke rising; the person grilling is wearing black gloves. (2) Hands using a large knife and tongs to slice a grilled sausage on a dark wooden cutting board. (3) A blurred shot of a crowded indoor food stall with customers seated at small wooden tables. (4) A metal ladle scoops a large pork bone and clear soup from a deep pot into a pink bowl. (5) A hand holds a large bone with meat attached over a bowl of soup to show its size. (6) A plated serving of sliced sausages, glutinous rice sausages, garlic cloves, and pickled cucumbers is presented. (7) Close-up of raw sausages hanging in dense rows inside the stall. (8) Chopsticks pick up a slice of glutinous rice sausage showing the cross-section with peanuts and grains. (9) A hand receives a pink number tag from a staff member at the counter. (10) Wide shot of the stall's storefront showing signage, exhaust pipes, and staff working.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female narration starts immediately over a steady, upbeat acoustic guitar and light percussion track. Background has a very faint sizzle of charcoal. (2) A sharp rhythmic thud sounds as a knife hits wood, marking the narrator's first description of the food. (3) A distinct liquid splashing sound occurs as soup is poured, with the narrator's tone remaining consistently cheerful and clear. (4) Multiple rapid rhythmic chopping sounds follow, synchronized with the discussion of the sausage textures. (5) A metallic clicking of tongs is audible under the vocal track. (6) Background chatter of a crowd rises slightly as the narration concludes with a friendly farewell; the music ends with a final acoustic strum.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Food Intro -> Detail Showcase (Soup/Sides/Texture) -> Store Info -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy food recommendation for a specific 30-year-old traditional sausage stall in Kaohsiung. It emphasizes the quality of handmade sausages and glutinous rice sausages, while also highlighting the unique 'free bone soup' benefit to entice local foodies and tourists.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed store name, address, and glowing review of the taste and perks (free soup) indicate a professional food blogger endorsement.
